# Planting
Right-click a bed with a soil (dirt, Loam, sand, soul sand), then a seed. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to take them back. Beds grow what the Glass Cloche grows (not saplings, flowers or Hops), and any ordinary crop from another mod in dirt or Loam. Loam makes a bed 1.25x as fast.
# Ports
- Input: fertilizer, water, Nutrient Solution and Carbon Dioxide (one face takes them all).
- Output: the harvest (turn on auto-eject).
- Energy: FE for the Grow Lamps only. By day under the sky it needs none, and the gauge stays full.
- Heat: HU to keep it warm.

# Growing
Each bed grows at 1x on water alone (50 mB a harvest; without water nothing grows), in warmth and light. More beds, more harvests. Each system it's fed makes every bed faster:
| System | Through | Effect |
| Nutrients | Nutrient Solution (25 mB), or fertilizer | x2 (plain fertilizer x1.5) |
| Carbon Dioxide | 20 mB a harvest | x1.3 |
| Heat | HU through a heat port | keeps it at 24°C |
| Grow Lamps | 16 FE/t each while lit | growth at night and without sky |
Fully fed, a bed grows 2.6x as fast, day and night.

# Climate
The air inside starts at the outside temperature: the biome's (plains about 20°C, snowy biomes 0°C), and a cold 5°C in the Nether and the End, which have no sky. By day under the sky the glass keeps it 6°C warmer.
Crops grow at full speed from 18 to 30°C, and 5% slower for every degree outside that (not at all 20°C outside it).
With heat in its buffer it heats itself up to 24°C, using about 4 HU/t plus 1 for every 20 blocks of wall and roof.
# Light
A bed grows by day if the sky shines on it through the glass. A lit Grow Lamp lights every bed within 3 blocks across of it, so lamps keep it growing at night, underground and in the Nether.
